facts.text: I am working on a product and I want help organizing my to-do list.
I recently had a breakthrough on my product development on May 15th.
I am working on a software product.
My short-term goal is to get a minimum viable product (MVP) out to some pilot customers.
I am struggling to find the right team members to help me with development.
I have tasks including finishing implementing the core features.
I have tasks including setting up the database.
I have tasks including designing the user interface.
I have tasks including figuring out the payment gateway.
I need to finalize the pricing model.
I need to create a sales page on my website.
For the payment gateway, I was thinking of using Stripe.
I think I will stick with Stripe for now.
Since my breakthrough on May 15th, I have been making rapid progress.
I am hoping to finalize the core features soon.
I am considering starting to test the product with a small group of users before launching it to the pilot customers.
I plan to recruit a small group of friends and family who are familiar with the industry to test the product.
I plan to reach out to a few potential customers who have expressed interest in my product to get their feedback.
I am wondering whether I should have a formal agreement or contract with alpha testers.
I am wondering whether a simple email or message explaining the purpose of the test is sufficient for alpha testers.

keyphrases: testing with small group of users

events.text: Considering testing the product with a small group before launching to pilot customers
